environment.description: FastAPI service deployed on AWS EC2 instance (m5.xlarge) in us-east-1 VPC. Instance has IAM role 'webhook-service-role' with S3 and DynamoDB permissions. IMDSv1 enabled (default). Service runs in Docker container with host networking mode. No egress filtering applied. HSM proxy accessible at hsm-proxy.internal:8443 via internal DNS. ALB forwards traffic on port 443 with no WAF attached.
